summary: PARTIAL PASS. Backend 27/27: new stats surface + full regression /app/backend/tests/test_ticker_stats_surface.py (17/17) and prior /app/backend/tests/test_ticker_desk_surfaces.py (10/10) all pass. GET /api/ticker/segment?surface=stats&league=nhl returns state=ready with grounded interpretation (blob references real leaders like McDavid/MacKinnon/Vasilevskiy and top teams Colorado/Dallas/Carolina/Buffalo — no fabricated stats). WHL stats desk returns ready and mentions real WHL teams/leaders (Regina/East). NHL beats are richer, WHL appropriately shorter. Cache reuse verified on both leagues. No compact score fragments in any league-level desk. Legacy /api/segment absent, TTS only after deliberate play. FRONTEND: HOME, RECAP (NHL+WHL), NEXT (NHL+WHL), STATS (NHL+WHL) all render <TickerDesk testID='ticker-desk'> with a deliberate PLAY control (testID='desk-play'). Zero autoplay on entering, scrolling, returning to a tab, or switching leagues (playCalls==0 across all traversals, getUserMedia==0, permQuery==0, legacy '/api/segment'==0). STATS play triggers TTS + audio (playCalls>=1, maxConcurrent==1). GLOBAL ONE-AUDIO-SESSION IS **BROKEN** for the four in-app tabs. After STATS PLAY, switching to HOME and pressing PLAY there produced playCalls=2 but only pauseCalls=1, and the concurrency counter reached maxConcurrent=2 — TWO HTMLAudioElements playing simultaneously. Root cause: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx lines 56–63 keep every visited tab mounted (display: 'none'|'flex') so the STATS TickerDesk never unmounts when the user moves to HOME. beginSession()/stopAudio() in /app/frontend/src/lib/audio.web.ts (or the TickerDesk supersede subscription) does not pause the still-mounted STATS TickerDesk's audio element before HOME starts its own — the two Audio() instances co-exist. Iteration 13's cross-page supersede worked ONLY because Team/Game pages are Expo-router deep routes that fully unmount on navigation; the four in-app tabs do NOT unmount, so the unmount-based endSession path never fires.

integration_issues.issue: Concurrent audio exceeded 1 (maxConcurrent=2, playCalls=2, pauseCalls=1) after STATS PLAY then HOME PLAY. TickerDesk from the previously-active tab keeps playing because tabs stay mounted; beginSession()/stopAudio() does not pause the other desk's Audio() instance. Violates the core acceptance rule 'never more than one audio stream at once'.

action_items: Fix the global one-audio-session bug for the four in-app tabs. Options: (a) in /app/frontend/src/lib/audio.web.ts, make stopAudio() truly stop the module-level currentAudio reference AND pause any playing HTMLAudioElement on the page (document.querySelectorAll('audio')) — this guarantees the previous tab's audio is silenced before the new one starts; (b) in TickerDesk, subscribeSession() must pause the local HTMLAudioElement (not just reset UI) when the desk is superseded; (c) alternatively, mount only the active tab's TickerDesk (unmount others) — but that regresses tab-switch latency. Recommend option (a)+(b) so the module-level session state actually enforces the invariant.
Re-run frontend concurrency test after fix: expect maxConcurrent<=1 across STATS→HOME→RECAP→NEXT plays.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx uses `visited` set to keep every entered tab mounted (line 38, 56–63). This is fine for scroll-state preservation but breaks the unmount-driven endSession() cleanup in /app/frontend/src/components/TickerDesk.tsx that iteration_13 relied on for cross-page supersede. The audio session invariant must therefore be enforced via subscribeSession() (imperative pause) — not via unmount.

Backend /app/backend/server.py line 790–812 stats branch is clean: signature-based cache key (top-East team + top scorer), Mongo cache_reuse verified, exception-safe fallback returns state=unavailable rather than throwing.

Backend /app/backend/ticker_recap.py build_stats_desk (line 641) task prompt correctly constrains hosts to interpret the numbers only — verified empirically: no goal/scored/scorer/empty-net language leaked into stats beats.

rca_of_issue: TickerDesk relies on its unmount effect to endSession() and (via subscribeSession) UI-reset when superseded. For deep routes (/team, /game) unmount runs on navigation — iteration_13 pass. For the four primary tabs, /app/frontend/app/index.tsx keeps every visited tab mounted using display:none, so the STATS TickerDesk keeps its HTMLAudioElement alive and playing after the user switches to HOME. When HOME's TickerDesk calls beginSession()->stopAudio(), stopAudio() apparently only pauses the module-tracked `currentAudio` reference, which is the *new* audio being created by the HOME desk (or otherwise fails to pause the STATS desk's independent Audio() instance). Net: two Audio elements playing at once. Fix must enforce the invariant imperatively via the session-supersede subscription (pause the local audio in TickerDesk when currentSession() != tokenRef) OR broaden stopAudio() to pause every <audio> element on the page.
